purpose: Resolve fixed barge-in/backchannel trials that repeatedly had no pre-existing speech overlap
controls: Same first caller utterance, silence afterward, original total duration; same native seed41
selection: After the first caller utterance ends, choose the earliest ASR word run with gaps at most 240 ms, at least 0.6 s before trigger and 1.4 s after trigger, and at least 75% of 20 ms waveform windows above -45 dBFS. If none qualifies, report inconclusive; do not search seeds.
trigger: Place the original second caller utterance at the next 80 ms frame boundary inside that interval. Re-encode complete caller PCM with fresh Mimi state; verify input-code prefix equality before trigger.
checks: Verify generated agent-code prefix equality before changed input can influence it
Verify actual decoded agent speech around caller onset in the interrupted trial
Compare stop/acknowledgment with uninterrupted control, and review semantic response
For backchannel, review continuation and speaker stability rather than requiring silence
timing_scope: Offline frame and waveform overlap. Agent output availability is logged per input frame; no live end-to-end latency claim.
interpretation: Additional diagnostic, not replacement of frozen results, not independent holdout, and not training data.
